Activists and observers said suspected ISIS militants killed seven people and injured four others at a Ramadan breakfast in Deir ez-Zor province in northeastern Syria.  Former QSD spokesman Nouri Hamish hosted the iftar banquet, marking the end of the day's fast, at his home in the town of Abu Lumba on Wednesday."
